took a shower and was thinking... 
  what if i dont remove v8? what if the game data is as it   
  stands now, but the game logic, like damage, or any of t   
  hat. is still inside of the v8 ? ok, i know where this     
  goes. 'your right back to the whole problem u escaped'     
  except, its not. think about it this way. in a browser, if 
  you have a css animation vs a js animation, and the js     
  needs to gc, what happens. well the js animation stutters, 
  the css animation just keeps going. ok. now, how long is   
  a gc in v8? lets say 30-50ms just to overshoot it. maybe   
  its longer, ive not ever really seen it to be. this is a   
  generous amount. ok, now, what is worse. you as the player 
  are lagging. or your shots that you shoot, land a frame    
  or two late? well, as a matter of fact, this is already    
  how gamers have trained their brain. Playing online games  
  is exactly this delay. think about it. i quit the game if  
  i go to awp down mid and i jump and rubber band back to my 
  spot. I keep playing if i awp down mid if i cant feel the  
  lag myself, but i question if the other player is on a     
  toaster. gc can be the exact same muscle memory of network 
  latency, as long as the gc can never affect the actual     
  input behavior of the player. now, v8 is still going to    
  just emit me back some data that goe into my loaders, but  
  it doesnt need to recompile the entire game, it just needs 
  to get a new array in there somewhere or change some       
  values of an existing. but as it stands, i dont see it     
  ever being something worse than 5-10ms of playing online   
  brings also
